questions.q:
With reference to the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (PM VGSY), consider the following statements:
1. It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31, co-terminus with the 16th Finance Commission period.
2. It also covers traditional local bodies in areas outside Part IX of the Constitution.
3. It creates permanent posts in Gram Panchayats.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the scheme creates no permanent posts. The outlay is Rs 7,395.55 crore (Centre Rs 4,869.48 crore, States Rs 2,526.07 crore), reaching about 32 lakh representatives in 2.55 lakh+ Panchayats. Development plans are prepared on eGramSwaraj and audit plans on AuditOnline, with Annual Action Plans approved by a Central Empowered Committee.

questions.q: 'PANCHAM', a component of the PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana, is
o: an AI-enabled two-way communication platform for Panchayats in 17 languages
a fund for Panchayats' own-source revenue
a ranking index of the best-performing Gram Panchayats
a training academy for elected women representatives
questions.e: PANCHAM is an AI-enabled, two-way platform used for awareness drives through Gram Sabhas, each meant to reach at least one crore citizens, in 17 languages. The scheme also supports capacity building for local SDGs and online accounts. The 16th Finance Commission recommended about Rs 4.35 lakh crore in grants to rural local bodies for 2026-31.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme:
1. It has an outlay of about Rs 1,856.67 crore for 2026 to 2033-34.
2. It plans Sports Goods Manufacturing Zones through convergence with BHAVYA and NICDC industrial parks.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both are correct. About Rs 1,130 crore goes to anchor investment support and turnover-linked support, and the scheme is aligned with the Khelo Bharat Niti, 2025. It aims to build domestic manufacturing of sports goods, a labour-intensive sector, by clustering firms in dedicated zones.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the SME Growth Fund approved by the Cabinet:
1. It is structured as an Alternative Investment Fund.
2. It mainly provides concessional working-capital loans to small enterprises.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 1 is correct. The Rs 10,000 crore Government commitment provides patient equity, not debt, for scalable, manufacturing-heavy SMEs, especially in Tier-II and Tier-III clusters. It is part of the Budget 2026-27 MSME package; equity helps firms that cannot grow on loans alone.

questions.q:
With reference to the report on India's Ayush service sector by the Research and Information System for Developing Countries (RIS), consider the following statements:
1. Ayurveda accounts for nearly half of Ayush service-sector revenue.
2. Women make up about 43% of the Ayush services workforce.
3. Medical value travel is the largest revenue segment.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; Ayurveda earns $17.73 billion of a $36.92 billion sector (FY 2024-25). Standalone clinics ($16.21 billion) and day-care ($10.13 billion) together bring over 70% of revenue, while medical value travel is only $1.77 billion. The sector has grown at 16.91% a year since FY23 and supports 1.76 million livelihoods.

questions.q: The 'Joint Squad for Health' (JOSH) teams set up for TB elimination are a joint initiative of which of the following Ministries?
o: Health and Family Welfare, Rural Development, and Panchayati Raj
Health and Family Welfare, Home Affairs, and Labour and Employment
Health and Family Welfare, Education, and Women and Child Development
Health and Family Welfare, Youth Affairs and Sports, and Defence
questions.e: JOSH teams in 55 districts of 11 States are joint Health, Youth Affairs and Sports, and Defence efforts, drawing on Class-I officers, MY Bharat volunteers and NCC cadets. They raise awareness on symptoms, diagnosis, treatment completion and stigma, under the Jan Bhagidari pillar of TB Mukt Bharat.

questions.q: The UN Global Initiative on AI for Agri-Food Systems (GI-AI4FS), which met alongside India Mobile Congress 2026, is coordinated by
questions.e: The ITU coordinates the initiative with the FAO, IFAD and WFP. The meeting was co-hosted by the Telecommunication Engineering Centre of the Department of Telecommunications and ICAR. It reflects the push to use AI in agriculture alongside India's Digital Agriculture Mission and AgriStack.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the National SARAS Mela held at Vijayawada:
1. It was the first National SARAS Mela held outside Delhi-NCR.
2. It showcased women self-help group entrepreneurs under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both are correct. About 1,500 SHG entrepreneurs and 'Lakhpati Didis' from 34 States and UTs took part, with NABARD and NIRDPR as partners; a 16-ft installation titled 'SHAKTI - The Spirit of Lakhpati Didi' marked it. The first SARAS Mela was held in Delhi in 1999.

questions.q:
With reference to the World Bank's first digital strategy, consider the following statements:
1. It rests on four areas: connectivity, affordability, digital services and skills, and AI readiness.
2. It emphasises large frontier AI models trained on global data.
3. Its AI Infrastructure and Readiness Initiative will begin in South Asia.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 1 is correct. The strategy stresses 'small AI', task-specific local tools, and its AI Infrastructure and Readiness Initiative, with shared pay-as-you-go GPUs and partners such as Cassava Technologies and NVIDIA, starts in Africa and Latin America. Over 2 billion people were offline in 2025; internet use is 23% in low-income against 94% in high-income countries.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. India's national waterway cargo rose from 18 million tonnes in 2013-14 to about 80 million tonnes in 2025-26.
2. A ship-repair facility at Haldia is among the investments planned for North-East waterways.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Neither is correct. Waterway cargo rose to 218 mt in 2025-26, and the ship-repair facility planned for the North-East is at Pandu, near Guwahati. Over Rs 68 billion is going to NE waterways. The first international cargo from eastern Assam since 1947 used NW-2 and the Indo-Bangladesh Protocol Route to Pangaon near Dhaka.
